reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{static boolean val(String v){if(v.isEmpty())return false;for(char c:v.toCharArray())if(c<32||c>126||c==','||c==';')return false;return true;}public static String labelOverlay(String s){String[]p=s.split(";",-1);if(p.length!=2)return null;var d=new TreeMap<String,String>();if(!p[0].isEmpty())for(String r:p[0].split(",",-1)){String[]q=r.split("=",2);if(q.length!=2||!q[0].matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*")||!val(q[1])||d.putIfAbsent(q[0],q[1])!=null)return null;}if(!p[1].isEmpty())for(String op:p[1].split(",",-1)){if(op.startsWith("set:")){String[]q=op.substring(4).split("=",2);if(q.length!=2||!q[0].matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*")||!val(q[1]))return null;d.put(q[0],q[1]);}else if(op.startsWith("unset:")&&op.substring(6).matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*"))d.remove(op.substring(6));else return null;}return d.entrySet().stream().map(e->e.getKey()+"="+e.getValue()).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.joining(","));}}
